append.detail: ── NARROWED + SLICE UNPARKED 2026-10-06 (ADR-1708, owner ruling). The Sites slice is built now on the Space page blocks, ahead of the full editor, with danieltyack.com first: phase 1 LIVE-741 (the site renders at /sites/<slug> with a publish switch), then host routing in proxy.ts, the danieltyack.com binding, site SEO and caching, each its own row. This row keeps what that slice leaves: self-serve domain binding through the Vercel API, a free subdomain on any paid plan, and site templates. Its probe is unchanged.
